sloka: एवमुक्तो हनुमता भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः ।पपात सहसा हृष्टो हर्षान्मोहं जगाम ह ।। ६.१२८.४० ।।
transliteration: evamukto hanumatā bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ ।papāta sahasā hṛṣṭo harṣānmohaṁ jagāma ha ।। 6.128.40 ।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana who is endowed with extraordinary energy, and illustrious Sita accompanied by Rama will be coming as Sachi with Mahendra."
